name: app-scope-of-work-four-sprint-staircase-slide
title: Scope of Work Four-Sprint Staircase
whatItIs: A light grey slide titled Scope of work with a paragraph on the right and four staggered stages stepping down: sprint pills with icons (1 to 4), each above a heading (Research, Strategy, UI Design, Delivery) and a short list of activities with a thin vertical rule.
whatItMeans: A downward staircase shows progress through time, and lists under each pill make scope clear.
techniques: Sprint pills with round icon buttons and faded end lines
Thin vertical rules beside each list
Small grey text for lists and larger for headings
Paragraph placed high right to balance the stair

vocabulary.definition: Items stepping down diagonally to show progression.
A capsule labelling a work sprint with an icon.
A list of activities included in a phase.
